scene: The funicular glides upward as glowing city roofs tilt below you.
beats: You twiddle the brass dial, filling the car with dreamy cosmic synth tunes just as the funicular docks and the glass doors slide open.
You peek inside the rattling crate, delighted by fluttering neon-green moths, until the car clunks to a halt and the observation deck doors slide open.
Twisting the brass periscope, you watch the sparkling comet streak overhead right as the arrival chime rings and the moonlit exit doors part wide.
picture: Inside a sloped glass-walled funicular, side view. Far left sits an operator by a brass radio console. Centre stands the player, facing right. Right sits a woman beside a rattling crate. Up high overhead hangs a brass periscope. Far right, the glass exit door frames dark sky.
shown: a crackling brass radio console on the far left wall
a rattling wooden crate with airholes sitting right beside a passenger
an overhead brass periscope mounted up high above the seats

after.label: Step off at Comet Watch Rooftop
Stay on
after.beat: You stay aboard as the funicular climbs into swirling mist, where a sleepy moth flutters by. At the terminus, a squeaky window-cleaner gondola carries you toward the clanking cloud tanks of Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: City lights blink in the purple dusk as the steep tram rattles upward.
beats: A twist of the small knob fills the cabin with warm synth melodies just as the car reaches its stop and the glass doors whisper open.
Through the drilled airholes, you spot glowing green wings fluttering softly, right as the brakes hiss and the station doors open.
You tilt the overhead lens to catch a shimmering comet tail across the night sky, just as the arrival bell dings and the exit opens.
variants.ride_on: Riding past the platform into thick night mist, you watch a lonely moth drift outside before switching to an old window-washing gondola heading for Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Warm yellow lamps glow while the night sky glides past the slanted glass.
beats: Fiddling with the receiver unlocks a cascade of starry synth chords just as the car bumps to a halt and the doors part.
Peering into the slotted timber box reveals vibrant neon moths inside, right when the tram docks smoothly and the exit doors slide back.
Swiveling the rooftop scope gives you a clear view of a blazing comet overhead, right as the tram settles and the doors glide open.
variants.ride_on: You stay seated as clouds swallow the rails and a tiny moth flits past, transferring at the final stop to a creaky gondola bound for Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: The funicular climbs steeply while you hum {tune} beneath the humming cabin lamps.

Looking between the wooden slats, bright green moths flutter in the shadows, right as the car clunks to a stop and the doors open.

variants.ride_on: Drifting on past the stop, a moth dances in the fog until the line ends, where a rattling gondola lifts you toward Rainmaker Rooftops.
